decisions: Add the SBI VISA Crypto Card as a confirmed XRP-selectable retail distribution channel.
Keep Aplus, Visa Japan, SBI VC Trade, SBI Securities, SBI Shinsei Bank and SBI Holdings as distinct entities.
Record automatic monthly reward conversion and the VCTRADE account requirement.
Record the SBI/Visa digital-finance MOU as exploratory and not XRP-specific.
Record SBI VC Trade's RLUSD listing with Ripple as a separate stablecoin distribution relationship.
Do not infer XRP spot demand, net external capital or proprietary SBI accumulation from card rewards or voucher face value.
Keep the May 2026 launch campaign separate from ongoing base card terms; verify current terms before describing them as active.
required_verification: Find current card terms and any revised reward schedule.
Obtain aggregate card issuance, XRP selection share and monthly XRP reward-credit quantities if publicly disclosed.
Verify SBI Shinsei voucher redemption and XRP units actually credited.
Determine whether reward XRP is sourced from spot execution, OTC, exchange inventory or internal transfers.
Verify whether RLUSD is paired with XRP on VCTRADE or used in an actual XRP settlement route.
